targets.words: The trade_date column of the transaction table, named as the field; the lot source reads it as the closing trade's trade date.
The settlmnt_date column of the transaction table, named as the settlement date. The round-123 absent claim is void: the live schema carries the column.

targets.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping to the ratified type word, then type_action (the type word to its action word); a code the mapping holds as UNMAPPED or lacks gives a null action.
targets.words: No column carries the action word itself. It is the action word of the type word the source code maps to.

targets.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its ratified type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
targets.words: The source code column read through the ratified source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
The ticker_symbol column, named as the security symbol; sources.json trade_identifier_columns names it first.

Searched every column for a security or issue name: none of the transaction table's columns is named as one. The security is identified by ticker_symbol and cusip (sources.json trade_identifier_columns). transaction_detail_description was considered and rejected: it is free transaction text that the producer carries for same-account type-transfer grammar, not a security name.
The quantity column, named as the units; the in-kind valuation reads quantity as the transferred units (sources.json inkind_quantity_column).
The price column of the transaction table; the in-kind price key reads it (sources.json inkind_price_column).

targets.method: gross_amount, the money column the adapter declares (money_column). The sign is taken from debit_credit on cash rows: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative (direction_map).
targets.words: gross_amount is the custodian's gross money amount, the money column the adapter declares. The sign is taken from debit_credit on cash rows; net_amount is never read.

targets.method: Per row, the sum of the fee-named columns listed in from_columns and of commission; null when every listed column is null. markupmarkdown is not summed (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm is not summed (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).
targets.words: The table holds nine fee-named or commission columns, so the fee is a computed total of them. Excluded columns are named in the method with the reason.

targets.method: The custodian identity column of the row (custdian_id). Its values are not read by the census; the claim is inferred from the column name.
targets.words: The custdian_id column, read as the custodian identity of the row. The census holds no values, so the value set is not read; the custody entry's registry constant remains the cross-check.

targets.method: Per the three-part key (tran_srcde, tr_cd, sb_cd) through the classification table's (partition, rule) rows: one class when the key's rows agree, UNRESOLVED when they disagree or the table does not hold the key. The silver-only codes and the two fixed codes are fixed in source_mapping.
targets.words: The classification key is the three transaction key columns; the table is keyed on them.

targets.method: The per-transaction cashiering identifier column, read by name; values not read.
targets.words: The cashiering_transaction_identifier column, read as the per-transaction identifier by its name. schwab_cashiering_unique_id is the other cashiering identifier and is not used. The census holds no values.

targets.method: MEASURED when tran_srcde maps to a type word; CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING when the mapping lacks the code; UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED.
targets.words: Coverage is a function of how the source code is covered by the mapping.
